gh issue create --title "Add Mermaid diagram export for IR graphs" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
Add functionality to export IR graphs to Mermaid diagram format for documentation and visualization purposes.

## Background
The IR (Intermediate Representation) system uses a Sea of Nodes graph-based structure. Being able to visualize these graphs as Mermaid diagrams would help with:
- Documentation generation
- Debugging complex graph structures
- Teaching/explaining the IR system
- Architectural discussions

## Proposed Implementation
Add a method (likely `to_mermaid()` or similar) to the IR graph classes that:
1. Traverses the IR graph nodes
2. Generates Mermaid syntax representing nodes and edges
3. Handles different node types (operations, control flow, data flow, etc.)
4. Produces valid Mermaid flowchart/graph syntax

## Example Output
For a simple IR graph, the output might look like:
```mermaid
graph TD
    Start[Start] --> Add[Add]
    Constant1[Constant: 1] --> Add
    Constant2[Constant: 2] --> Add
    Add --> Return[Return]
```

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Can export any IR graph to valid Mermaid syntax
- [ ] Different node types are visually distinguishable
- [ ] Control flow and data flow edges are clearly represented
- [ ] Generated diagrams render correctly in Mermaid viewers
- [ ] Add tests for Mermaid export functionality

## Related
This would complement existing IR visualization and debugging capabilities.
EOF
)" --label "type:enhancement" --label "component: IR" --label "effort: medium" --label "impact: low"
